main.title: Speaker Recognition
main.description: Connect to the Speaker Recognition backend and optionally add voice samples to train users.

data_description.backend_url: URL of the Speaker Recognition server (e.g. http://localhost:8099)
data_description.voice_samples: For each user, select one or more audio files to train their voice

menu.title: Add a proxy
menu.description: Add a proxy entity that adds speaker recognition to an existing speech-to-text or conversation entity.

add_stt.title: Add STT proxy
add_stt.description: Wrap a speech-to-text entity so the speaker is recognised from the spoken audio. Use the created proxy entity in your Assist pipeline.

add_conversation.title: Add conversation proxy
add_conversation.description: Wrap a conversation agent so the recognised speaker is passed to it. Use the created proxy entity in your Assist pipeline.

data_description.min_confidence: Minimum recognition confidence (0.0-1.0) required before the recognised speaker is applied

error.not_stt_entity: The selected entity is not a speech-to-text entity
error.not_conversation_entity: The selected entity is not a conversation agent
